project_overview.name: NFL_ML_Predictions
project_overview.description: NFL game prediction system with FastAPI backend, React frontend, and ML models

train_models.py._ensure_columns: Validate required columns exist in DataFrame
train_models.py._dataset_hash: Generate reproducible hash for dataset versioning
train_models.py._drop_leaky_columns: Remove columns that could leak target information
train_models.py._infer_features: Separate numeric and categorical feature columns
train_models.py._dataset_sort: Sort dataset chronologically by season and week
train_models.py._get_holdout_split: Reserve final chronological portion for holdout
train_models.py._fit_regression: Fit regression model with hyperparameter search
train_models.py._fit_classifier: Fit binary classifier with hyperparameter search
train_models.py._evaluate_regression: Compute regression metrics on holdout set
train_models.py._evaluate_classifier: Compute classifier metrics on holdout set
train_models.py._extract_feature_importance: Extract feature importance from trained model

interactions.train_models.py -> backend/models/: Outputs: preprocessor.joblib, home_model.joblib, away_model.joblib, win_clf_calibrated.joblib, metadata.json, training_report.json, feature_importance.json
interactions.train_models.py <- backend/data/: Input: game_features_2014_2025.csv or other CSV datasets
interactions.main.py <- backend/models/: Loads trained models for prediction API

data_shapes.TrainingSummary: Comprehensive training run summary with metrics and params
